verdict.rationale: Conta Simples' own marketing lists boleto payment, batch payments, free Pix, and an approvals area, and its API manages suppliers and links invoices to transactions. Together these point to basic payables capability inside the platform. However, approval routing is only named, never described. Invoice handling covers attaching documents to existing transactions rather than capturing bills for payment. The documented payment rails are Brazilian (Pix, boleto), not the ACH, check, or wire the story asks for. Missing for 10: invoice capture/intake for unpaid bills, documented approval routing workflows, vendor payment by ACH, check, or wire, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can run accounts payable in the same platform — capture invoices, route approvals, and pay vendors by ACH, check, or wire
